versions.content: The Ea module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter EaNvMJobEndNotification upon successful end of an asynchronous block invalidation operation after performing all necessary internal management operations. Successful end of an asynchronous block invalidation operation implies the block invalidation job is finished and the result is OK (i.e. the block has been marked as invalid).
